title: Scalar transport through inverse-image stalk identifications
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a scheme morphism [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], x\in X, y=f(x), R=(f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y)_x, S=\mathcal O_{X,x}, A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}, and ψ:f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X the adjoint ring map [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let η_G be the unit of the explicit inverse-image adjunction for the underlying abelian sheaf [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module]. There exists a family of S-linear isomorphisms β_G:S\otimes_{A,f^\sharp_x}\mathcal G_y\cong S\otimes_{R,ψ_x}(f^{-1}\mathcal G)_x, for all O_Y-modules G, with β_G(1\otimes s_y)=1\otimes(η_G(s))_x for every section s on a neighborhood V of y. Stalk module structures are those of [def-pc-module-stalk-functor].

proof.text: Apply exists_inverseImage_stalk_iso_commRing and exists_inverseImage_stalk_iso_ab from lem-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image-stalk. The private proved helper explicitStalkComparison transports each comparison to inverseImageConstruction of def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module using Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq. Map the comparison isomorphism through the forgetful and stalk functors; unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app and stalkFunctor_map_germ give its formula for the explicit sheafAdjunctionContinuous unit.

proof.text: Represent an original ring stalk element a and a module stalk element m over a common neighborhood V. The semilinearity of the inverse-image module unit, and the stalk formula for multiplication, give c_G(a m)=c_R(a)c_G(m). The ring-map adjunction identity ψ η_R=f sharp implies ψ_x(c_R(a))=f.stalkMap x(a), first on germs and then on all elements since every ring stalk element is a germ.

proof.text: The private proved helper scalarTransport implements the balanced tensor construction using Mathlib ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.homEquiv. Given the ring equivalence e, additive equivalence c, c(a m)=e(a)c(m), and psi(e(a))=phi(a), compose c with the extension/restriction unit for psi; its scalar compatibility makes an A-linear map into the restricted target tensor. Apply homEquiv.symm to obtain the S-linear forward map. Likewise compose c inverse with the unit for phi. Its linearity follows by applying c to c inverse(r n)=e inverse(r)c inverse(n), and using the ring compatibility at e inverse(r). The apply_symm_apply identity for the Hom equivalence and extendRestrictScalarsAdj_unit_app_apply prove the forward and reverse formulas on 1 tensor m. ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext reduces both composite identities to these formulas and the inverse identities of c. This gives the S-linear tensor isomorphism; there is no extra theorem assumed.

proof.text: For m the germ of s, the formula for c_G gives c_G(m)=germ of η_G(s). Substituting b=1 in the construction of β_G gives the displayed formula. Choose this family of isomorphisms for each G; its values are determined on generators by this construction. Naturality of the final pullback stalk comparison is proved separately in the parent Lean module, not assumed here.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_inverseImage_stalk_scalar_transport {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    ∃ β : ∀ G : Y.Modules,
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (f.stalkMap x).hom).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace (f x)).obj G) ≅
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat x).map
            (tensorPullbackRingMap f).hom).hom).obj
          (ModuleCat.of (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := CommRingCat.{u}) (X := X.toTopCat)
            (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf).obj x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := X.toTopCat)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule f.base Y.sheaf G).val.presheaf x)),
      ∀ (G : Y.Modules) (V : Y.Opens) (hx : f x ∈ V) (s : G.val.obj (op V)),
        (β G).hom ((1 : X.presheaf.stalk x) ⊗ₜ[_, (f.stalkMap x).hom]
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf V (f x) hx s)) =
        (1 : (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat x).obj X.sheaf.obj) ⊗ₜ[
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := CommRingCat.{u}) (X := X.toTopCat)
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf).obj x,
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat x).map
            (tensorPullbackRingMap f).hom).hom]
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
            (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule f.base Y.sheaf G).val.presheaf
            (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) x hx
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
              (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).unit.app
                ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj G)).hom.app (op V) s))
